brand.name: AI Crop Assistant
brand.description: Identify crop diseases, understand symptoms, and get crop-care guidance using AI.

landing.heroTitle: Protect Your Crops with Instant AI Diagnosis
landing.heroSubtitle: Upload a photo or speak your crop name in your native language. Get fast disease detection, organic remedies, and expert treatment plans.
landing.featuresTitle: Why Farmers Trust AI Crop Assistant
landing.featuresSubtitle: Tailored to Indian farming conditions with voice recognition and offline support
landing.feature1Desc: State-of-the-art AI vision spots fungal, bacterial, and pest damage in seconds.
landing.feature2Desc: Just speak your crop name in Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada, and 9 more languages.
landing.feature3Desc: Get neem-based organic sprays as well as scientific chemical treatment schedules.
landing.feature4Desc: Compressed images and offline crop database ensure it works even in remote fields.
landing.feature5Desc: Generate printable advisory reports with symptoms and dosage to take to your local agri store.
landing.feature6Desc: Ask follow-up questions anytime by typing or speaking in your mother tongue.
landing.step1Desc: Pick your preferred Indian language anytime.
landing.step2Desc: Type or use the 🎤 microphone to speak your crop name.
landing.step3Desc: Take a clear picture of the infected leaf, stem, or fruit.
landing.step4Desc: Receive disease name, severity, remedies, and listen aloud.
landing.personaSubtitle: Smart farming assistance for better crops and better decisions.

dashboard.welcomeSub: Here is your agricultural health overview and quick diagnostic center.
dashboard.quickAnalysisDesc: Detect leaf spots, wilting, rust, or pest infestations in seconds.
dashboard.noRecent: No recent scans yet. Click below to start your first analysis!
dashboard.weatherTip: High humidity detected (82%). Watch out for fungal leaf blast and powdery mildew in tomato and paddy fields.
dashboard.tip1: Spray 5% Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE) at the first sighting of whiteflies.
dashboard.tip2: Maintain proper drainage in paddy fields to prevent bacterial leaf blight.
dashboard.tip3: Apply Trichoderma viride to soil before transplanting chilli seedlings.
dashboard.askAssistantPrompt: Have a farming question? Ask your AI Crop Doctor anytime!
